layout.heading: Settings
layout.description: Manage your center settings and preferences.
general.title: General
general.logoHint: Max size 2MB. PNG or JPG recommended.
general.centerNameDescription: This name will be displayed in the navigation and emails.
general.brandColorDescription: Your center's primary color. Used for buttons and highlights.
general.timezoneDescription: The default timezone for schedules and attendance.
billing.heading: Billing
billing.description: View your billing status, student usage, and payment history.
billing.errorOverview: Unable to load billing information. Only center owners can access billing.
billing.exceedsWarning: You have {{enrolledStudents}} students enrolled. This plan supports up to {{maxStudents}} students. Excess students may be affected when the downgrade takes effect.
billing.downgradeDescription: You have {{enrolledStudents}} students enrolled. The {{tierName}} plan supports up to {{maxStudents}} students. Excess students may be affected when the downgrade takes effect at the next billing cycle.
billing.usageTrackingStarts: Student count tracking starts next month.
billing.paymentHistoryEmpty: No payments yet. Billing will start after pilot.
tags.heading: Topic Tags
tags.description: Manage topic tags for organizing exercises. Tags are shared across all exercises in your center.
tags.empty: No tags defined yet. Add a tag above.
tags.deleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete "{{tagName}}"? This will remove it from {{count}} exercise(s).
tags.mergeDescription: Merge "{{sourceTagName}}" into another tag. All exercises with this tag will be reassigned to the target tag, and "{{sourceTagName}}" will be deleted.
tags.toastCreateFailed: Failed to create tag. It may already exist.
tags.toastUpdateFailed: Failed to update tag. Name may already exist.
ai.heading: AI Customization
ai.description: Train the AI to match your center's feedback style.
ai.descriptionFull: Upload Golden Samples to train the AI on your center's feedback style. The AI will adopt the tone, vocabulary, and pedagogical approach from your samples.
ai.errorMessage: Only the center owner can manage AI customization settings.
ai.emptyWriting: No Writing golden samples yet. Add samples to train the AI on your feedback style.
ai.emptySpeaking: No Speaking golden samples yet. Add samples to train the AI on your feedback style.
ai.deleteDescription: This will permanently remove this golden sample. The AI will no longer use it as a style reference.
ai.goldenSample.studentWorkPlaceholder: Paste the student's original text here (min 50 characters)...
ai.goldenSample.teacherFeedbackPlacehold: Paste the teacher's feedback here (min 50 characters)...
integrations.heading: Integrations
integrations.description: Connect external services to your center.
integrations.comingSoonDescription: Google Calendar, email notifications, and billing integrations will be available in future updates.
rooms.heading: Rooms
rooms.description: Manage room names for scheduling. These appear in the room dropdown when creating or editing sessions.
rooms.empty: No rooms defined yet. Add a room above.
rooms.deleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete "{{roomName}}"? Existing sessions using this room will keep their room name but it won't appear in the dropdown.
rooms.toastCreateFailed: Failed to create room. It may already exist.
rooms.toastUpdateFailed: Failed to update room. Name may already exist.
privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.description: Manage data privacy and compliance settings.
privacy.comingSoonDescription: Data sovereignty controls and privacy center will be available in Epic 8.
moderation.heading: Compliance
moderation.errorMessage: Only Admins and Owners can access compliance settings.
moderation.descriptionFull: Content moderation and compliance review workspace.
moderation.noFlagSelected: Select a flag to view details
moderation.redactPlaceholder: Enter the redacted version of the content...
moderation.deleteDescription: This will permanently remove the flagged content. This action cannot be undone.
moderation.termsHelp: Enter one prohibited term per line. Maximum 500 terms, 100 characters each.
moderation.resetDescription: This will replace your custom term list with the default Vietnamese compliance terms. Custom terms will be lost.
